_comment: Vườn nhà: what grows, what a seed costs in the shop and what a harvest gives. Read by garden_catalog.py at startup; change numbers here, never in the app. Only add plants and seed ids (they are stored in inventories and plots). A plant without seed_price is not sold (its seed comes from walks). Balance rules are tested in tests/test_garden_economy.py.
